correctness.rationale: The total cut convention uses complements of exactly the 276 independent triples of P4□P4 (16 vertices, 24 edges), giving 64,900 augmented faces and a pure 12-complex. Independently enumerated the face set and greedy vertex-wise Morse matching: 32,432 disjoint facet-cover pairs, with per-vertex counts [32232,53,46,21,17,13,10,12,11,7,4,6,0,0,0,0]. The full 516,080-arc matched-edge-reversed Hasse graph is a DAG by an independent complete 64,900-vertex topological sort; exactly 36 unmatched 10-faces survive and the empty face was paired, so ordinary Morse has one critical vertex plus 36 critical 10-faces. Standard discrete Morse then yields wedge^36 S^10 and integral Htilde_10=Z^36; pure dimension 12 implies non-shellability. Independently computed orientation-corrected reduced Lefschetz traces for the eight D4 elements [36,0,4,0,6,6,6,6]. The 9-square action on 36 unordered pairs has class traces [36,4,0,6,6], yielding abstract rational permutation module and D4 multiplicities (8,2,5,5,8). The computation is exhaustive for this one finite complex and does not extrapolate to larger grids.

value.rationale: The 4×4 grid and total three-cut operation are natural objects in an active classification problem. Determining a full 36-sphere wedge homotopy type, rather than an already tabulated Betti rank, plus its complete D4 rational representation, answers two meaningful open finite invariants and can be compared with grid-family topology and symmetry conjectures.

scientific_limitations: One finite graph P4□P4; no all-grid or integral D4 lattice theorem.
Earlier beta_10=36 is not new; homotopy and rational character are the assessed additions.
Non-shellability conclusion follows from pure 12-dimensionality and nonzero Htilde_10.
